_why: Businesses found and deliberately left out, with the rule that excludes them. The search results do not forget them; this file is how the directory does not re-litigate a settled ruling. Consulted by verify-candidates.py. A ruling that KEEPS something in lives here too, so the reason survives with the businesses it applies to.

truck-diesel-shops.rule: A truck, diesel or fleet business that also takes RVs is not an RV business. Ty, 2026-09-28: "no truck stops itll get too confusing".

Truck repair business with a diesel mechanic line. Its 24/7 is roadside TRUCK repair, and its mobile RV work is by appointment only.
Truck service and body shop. Its RV work is body and collision, and its only 24/7 claim is a roadside assistance line.
Heavy-duty class 6, 7 and 8 truck shop that also takes RVs. Its own page says so.
Gallup, New Mexico. Own site, phone and a 24-hour number, but plainly a truck and diesel shop.

Idaho Falls. General auto shop that also does RVs.

businesses.n: J & J Truck Repair and Parts
businesses.why: Describes itself as 'a truck and RV repair shop' and tags itself a truck shop. A truck business that also takes RVs is not an RV business (Ty, 2026-09-28).
A diesel truck and RV repair shop whose mechanics have 'over 70 years of diesel truck repair experience'. Diesel-first, RV offered alongside. Same rule.
An auto repair shop that 'also advertises RV service'. General auto first, RV as an add-on, which is not what the directory lists.

A truck service and towing business in Danville that 'repairs and maintains motorhomes and RVs as well as trucks'. Truck-first, RV as an addition, which is the shape Ty's rule excludes however good the RV page is.

service-not-repair.rule: The directory is REPAIR. Cleaning, detailing, inspection and tank service stay out even when the business is RV-only and has its own site. Ty, 2026-09-28 on Park & Purge: "Nah thats not the same and not really what people are looking for."

businesses.why: Uvalde, Texas. RV-only and mobile, but does tank and water-heater cleaning rather than repair.
Colorado. Inspections and tank cleaning only.
Arizona. RV glass only, not repair.
Arizona. RV glass only, not repair.

dead-websites.rule: The business's own website no longer exists (404 on the root and on www). A listing rests on the site being checkable, so it cannot be verified. Re-add if the site returns.

dealer-service-departments.rule: A DEALER'S SERVICE DEPARTMENT STAYS IN, even where its site does not say in so many words that it takes outside work. Ty, 2026-10-06: "I agree leave them." The truck-shop and service-not-repair rules do not reach it, because a service bay is a real place to take a coach to, which is what this directory is for. Listed here so a future pass does not flag them again as unverified: eight were flagged by the California audit on 2026-10-02 and the ruling is to keep all eight.
